# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
features/fundamentals.py
Fundamenty dla XAUUSD: realne stopy (DGS10 - T10YIE), USD index (np. FRED),
GPR (Caldara & Iacoviello), COT Gold (CFTC). As-of alignment i FFill -> M5.

Wymaga: pandas, numpy, (opcjonalnie) fredapi, requests, python-dotenv.
Źródła:
- FRED: DGS10, T10YIE (real 10y = DGS10 - T10YIE)      [St. Louis Fed]  # cite: turn2search20
- CFTC COT (COMEX Gold) weekly                          # cite: turn2search9
- GPR (Caldara & Iacoviello) monthly                    # cite: turn2search28
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import os, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    load_dotenv()
except Exception:
    pass

# ---------- Utils ----------

def _zscore(s: pd.Series, win: int = 252) -> pd.Series:
    mu = s.rolling(win, min_periods=max(10, win//10)).mean()
    sd = s.rolling(win, min_periods=max(10, win//10)).std().replace(0, np.nan)
    return (s - mu) / (sd + 1e-12)

def _ensure_dt_utc(s: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    if not isinstance(s.index, pd.DatetimeIndex):
        raise ValueError("Index must be DatetimeIndex")
    if s.index.tz is None:
        s.index = s.index.tz_localize("UTC")
    else:
        s.index = s.index.tz_convert("UTC")
    return s

def _asof_ffill_daily_to_m5(daily: pd.Series,
                            bars_m5: pd.DataFrame,
                            available_hour_utc: int = 23,
                            available_minute_utc: int = 59) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Dla wartości dziennych zakładamy, że 'stają się znane' o available_* UTC.
    Każda wartość jest użyta od (data, available_time) do kolejnej publikacji.
    To zachowuje konserwatywność (eliminuje look-ahead).
    """
    s = daily.copy()
    s = _ensure_dt_utc(s)
    # Utnij do zakresu świec
    s = s[(s.index <= bars_m5['time'].max())]
    if s.empty:
        return pd.Series(index=bars_m5.index, dtype=float)

    # Tworzymy serię znaczników as-of
    idx_asof = []
    vals = []
    for ts, val in s.items():
        ts_asof = pd.Timestamp(ts.date(), tz=timezone.utc) + timedelta(
            hours=available_hour_utc, minutes=available_minute_utc)
        idx_asof.append(ts_asof)
        vals.append(val)
    asof_series = pd.Series(vals, index=pd.DatetimeIndex(idx_asof, tz="UTC")).sort_index()

    # Reindeks do M5 time i ffill
    m5_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(bars_m5['time']).tz_convert("UTC")
    out = asof_series.reindex(m5_idx, method="ffill")
    out.name = daily.name
    return out

# ---------- FRED ----------

def load_fred_series(series_id: str, api_key: str | None) -> pd.Series:
    """
    Ładuje serię z FRED (jeśli brak fredapi/klucza -> spodziewa się CSV w external/fred/{series_id}.csv)
    CSV format: DATE,VALUE
    """
    try:
        from fredapi import Fred  # type: ignore
    except Exception:
        Fred = None

    if Fred is not None and api_key:
        fred = Fred(api_key=api_key)
        s = fred.get_series(series_id)
        s = s.dropna().astype(float)
        s.index = pd.to_datetime(s.index, utc=True)
        s.name = series_id
        return s

    # Fallback: lokalny CSV
    p = Path("external/fred") / f"{series_id}.csv"
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Brak {p}. Zainstaluj fredapi lub umieść CSV.")
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df['DATE'] = pd.to_datetime(df['DATE'], utc=True)
    s = pd.Series(df.iloc[:, 1].astype(float).values, index=df['DATE'], name=series_id)
    return s

def build_real10y_and_usd(bars_m5: pd.DataFrame,
                          fred_key: str | None,
                          usd_series_id: str = "DTWEXBGS",
                          real_asof_hh: int = 23,
                          real_asof_mm: int = 59) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Zwraca DataFrame z kolumnami: real10y, real10y_z, d_real10y, usd, usd_z
    - real10y = DGS10 - T10YIE (oba dzienne)  # cite: turn2search20
    - usd = indeks USD (np. DTWEXBGS z FRED)  # cite: turn2search25
    """
    dgs10 = load_fred_series("DGS10", fred_key)
    t10yie = load_fred_series("T10YIE", fred_key)
    real10y_daily = (dgs10 - t10yie).dropna()
    usd_daily = load_fred_series(usd_series_id, fred_key).dropna()

    real10y_m5 = _asof_ffill_daily_to_m5(real10y_daily, bars_m5, real_asof_hh, real_asof_mm)
    usd_m5     = _asof_ffill_daily_to_m5(usd_daily,     bars_m5, 23, 59)

    # pochodne
    real10y_z = _zscore(real10y_m5, 252*24*12//5)  # ~252 dni w M5 ≈ 12*24*252/5
    d_real10y = real10y_m5.diff()

    usd_z = _zscore(usd_m5, 252*24*12//5)

    out = pd.DataFrame({
        'real10y': real10y_m5.values,
        'real10y_z': real10y_z.values,
        'd_real10y': d_real10y.values,
        'usd': usd_m5.values,
        'usd_z': usd_z.values
    }, index=bars_m5.index)
    return out

# ---------- GPR ----------

def load_gpr_local_csv(path: str = "external/gpr/gpr.csv") -> pd.Series:
    """
    Oczekuje miesięcznego GPR z kolumnami ['date','gpr'], gdzie date to YYYY-MM-01 UTC.
    Oryginał i metodologia: Caldara & Iacoviello (AER 2022)                      # cite: turn2search28
    Pobrane dane umieść offline – unikamy look-ahead przez FFill miesięczny.
    """
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Brak {p}. Pobierz GPR i zapisz jako CSV.")
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], utc=True)
    s = pd.Series(df['gpr'].astype(float).values, index=df['date'], name='gpr')
    return s

def gpr_to_m5(bars_m5: pd.DataFrame, gpr_monthly: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    gpr_monthly = _ensure_dt_utc(gpr_monthly)
    # As-of: konserwatywnie początek kolejnego miesiąca 00:00 UTC
    idx_asof = [pd.Timestamp(ts.year + (1 if ts.month==12 else 0),
                             1 if ts.month==12 else ts.month+1, 1, tz="UTC") for ts in gpr_monthly.index]
    s_asof = pd.Series(gpr_monthly.values, index=pd.DatetimeIndex(idx_asof, tz="UTC")).sort_index()
    m5_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(bars_m5['time']).tz_convert('UTC')
    gpr_m5 = s_asof.reindex(m5_idx, method='ffill')
    gpr_m5.name = 'gpr'
    return gpr_m5

# ---------- COT (Gold) ----------

def load_cot_gold_local_csv(path: str = "external/cot_gold.csv") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Oczekuje tygodniowego COT dla Gold (COMEX): kolumny ['date','mm_long','mm_short'] dla Managed Money.
    Dane z CFTC (Disaggregated report).                               # cite: turn2search9
    """
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Brak {p}. Przygotuj eksport z CFTC i zapisz CSV.")
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], utc=True)
    return df[['date','mm_long','mm_short']].sort_values('date')

def cot_to_m5(bars_m5: pd.DataFrame, cot_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cot_df = cot_df.copy()
    cot_df['mm_net'] = cot_df['mm_long'].astype(float) - cot_df['mm_short'].astype(float)
    # Publikacja: piątek (as-of), dane na wtorek – używamy konserwatywnie od piątku 21:00 UTC
    asof_ts = cot_df['date'] + pd.Timedelta(days=3)  # wtorek -> piątek
    asof_ts = asof_ts.dt.tz_localize('UTC') + pd.Timedelta(hours=21)
    ser = pd.Series(cot_df['mm_net'].values, index=asof_ts, name='cot_mm_net').sort_index()

    m5_idx = pd.DatetimeIndex(bars_m5['time']).tz_convert("UTC")
    mm_net_m5 = ser.reindex(m5_idx, method='ffill')
    mm_net_z  = _zscore(mm_net_m5, 52)  # roczny tygodniowy zscore
    out = pd.DataFrame({'cot_mm_net': mm_net_m5.values, 'cot_mm_net_z': mm_net_z.values}, index=bars_m5.index)
    return out

# ---------- Orkiestracja ----------

def build_fundamentals_features(bars_csv: str,
                                fred_api_key: str | None,
                                gpr_csv: str | None = None,
                                cot_csv: str | None = None,
                                usd_series_id: str = "DTWEXBGS") -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Ładuje bars M5, dokleja fundamenty (real10y/usd/gpr/cot) jako cechy na indeksie świec M5.
    """
    bars = pd.read_csv(bars_csv, parse_dates=['time']).sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
    core = build_real10y_and_usd(bars, fred_api_key, usd_series_id)

    cols = [core]
    if gpr_csv:
        gpr = load_gpr_local_csv(gpr_csv)
        gpr_m5 = gpr_to_m5(bars, gpr)
        cols.append(pd.DataFrame({'gpr': gpr_m5.values, 'gpr_z': _zscore(gpr_m5, 36).values}, index=core.index))
    if cot_csv:
        cot = load_cot_gold_local_csv(cot_csv)
        cols.append(cot_to_m5(bars, cot))

    out = pd.concat(cols, axis=1)
    out.insert(0, 'time', bars['time'].values)
    return out

def init_mt5():
    """Initialize MT5 i wypisz krótkie info o terminalu/koncie."""
    if not ensure_mt5_ready():
        last_err = mt5.last_error()
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"MT5 not ready (terminal/account). Start MT5 and login. last_error={last_err}"
        )
    term = mt5.terminal_info()
    acc = mt5.account_info()
    parts = []
    if getattr(term, "company", None):
        parts.append(f"Company={term.company}")
    if getattr(term, "name", None):
        parts.append(f"TerminalName={term.name}")
    if getattr(acc, "login", 0):
        parts.append(f"Login={acc.login}")
    if getattr(acc, "server", None):
        parts.append(f"Server={acc.server}")
    if getattr(acc, "name", None):
        parts.append(f"AccountName={acc.name}")
    print("[MT5] " + " | ".join(parts) if parts else "[MT5] initialized")


def ensure_symbol(symbol: str) -> bool:
    """Upewnij się, że symbol jest widoczny w Market Watch."""
    info = mt5.symbol_info(symbol)
    if info is None:
        mt5.symbol_select(symbol, True)
        info = mt5.symbol_info(symbol)
        if info is None:
            return False
    if not info.visible:
        if not mt5.symbol_select(symbol, True):
            return False
    return True


def suggest_similar(symbol: str, limit=12):
    """Podpowiedz nazwy symboli powiązanych (np. GOLD/XAU) – zależne od serwera."""
    out = []
    try:
        for s in mt5.symbols_get():
            nm = s.name.upper()
            if ("GOLD" in nm) or ("XAU" in nm):
                out.append(s.name)
        if not out:
            out = [s.name for s in mt5.symbols_get()][:limit]
        return sorted(set(out))[:limit]
    except Exception:
        return []

def with_retries(fn, attempts=3, sleep_s=2, *a, **kw):
    last = None
    for i in range(attempts):
        try:
            return fn(*a, **kw)
        except Exception as e:
            last = e
            time.sleep(sleep_s * (i + 1))
    if last:
        raise last


def _to_df(rates) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Konwersja stawek MT5 -> kanoniczny DataFrame z sanity-checkiem kolumn i czasu."""
    df = pd.DataFrame(rates)
    if df.empty:
        return df
    df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"], unit="s", utc=True)
    if "real_volume" in df.columns:
        df.rename(columns={"real_volume": "tick_volume"}, inplace=True)
    cols = ["time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "tick_volume", "spread"]
    # zachowaj tylko znane kolumny
    df = df[[c for c in cols if c in df.columns]].copy()
    # usuń zduplikowane nazwy i rekordy
    df = (
        df.loc[:, ~df.columns.duplicated()]
        .sort_values("time")
        .drop_duplicates("time")
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    return df


def _make_naive(dt: datetime) -> datetime:
    """Zwróć 'naive' datetime (bez tzinfo) – część brokerów tego wymaga dla copy_rates_range."""
    if dt.tzinfo is not None:
        return dt.replace(tzinfo=None)
    return dt


# ============================================================
# Pobieranie danych
# ============================================================
def fetch_range(symbol, timeframe, utc_from: datetime, utc_to: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Pobierz zakres 'range' z obejściami:
      • daty 'naive' (bez tzinfo),
      • fallback: tail od końca (copy_rates_from_pos) gdy range zwraca pustkę/Invalid params.
    """
    frm_n = _make_naive(utc_from)
    to_n = _make_naive(utc_to)
    rates = mt5.copy_rates_range(symbol, timeframe, frm_n, to_n)
    if rates is None or len(rates) == 0:
        # fallback: tail od końca
        tail = mt5.copy_rates_from_pos(symbol, timeframe, 0, CHUNK)
        if tail is None or len(tail) == 0:
            last_err = mt5.last_error()
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"copy_rates_range empty for '{symbol}'. last_error={last_err}"
            )
        return _to_df(tail)
    return _to_df(rates)


def fetch_from_pos_tail(symbol, timeframe, count) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rates = mt5.copy_rates_from_pos(symbol, timeframe, 0, count)
    if rates is None or len(rates) == 0:
        last_err = mt5.last_error()
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"copy_rates_from_pos empty for '{symbol}'. last_error={last_err}"
        )
    return _to_df(rates)


def load_existing_bars(path: str):
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        return None
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=["time"])
        if df.empty:
            return None
        # Usuń kolumny techniczne i duplikaty nazw
        bad = [c for c in df.columns if str(c).startswith("Unnamed")]
        if bad:
            df = df.drop(columns=bad)
        df = df.loc[:, ~df.columns.duplicated()]
        keep = ["time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "tick_volume", "spread"]
        df = df[[c for c in keep if c in df.columns]].copy()
        # Upewnij się, że 'time' jest UTC-aware
        if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(df["time"]):
            if df["time"].dt.tz is None:
                df["time"] = df["time"].dt.tz_localize("UTC")
            else:
                df["time"] = df["time"].dt.tz_convert("UTC")
        else:
            df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"], utc=True)
        df = (
            df.sort_values("time")
            .drop_duplicates("time")
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )
        return df
    except Exception:
        return None


def merge_clip(existing: pd.DataFrame | None, new_df: pd.DataFrame, keep_days: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Scal istniejące i nowe świece, deduplikuj po 'time', przytnij do keep_days i oczyść nagłówki."""
    def _sanitize(d):
        if d is None or d.empty:
            return d
        d = d.loc[:, ~d.columns.duplicated()]
        bad = [c for c in d.columns if str(c).startswith("Unnamed")]
        if bad:
            d = d.drop(columns=bad)
        return d

    existing = _sanitize(existing)
    new_df = _sanitize(new_df)

    if existing is None or existing.empty:
        base = new_df.copy()
    else:
        common = [c for c in existing.columns if c in new_df.columns]
        base = (
            pd.concat([existing[common], new_df[common]], axis=0, ignore_index=True, copy=False)
            .drop_duplicates("time")
            .sort_values("time")
        )
    # time -> UTC-aware
    if pd.api.types.is_datetime64_any_dtype(base["time"]):
        if base["time"].dt.tz is None:
            base["time"] = base["time"].dt.tz_localize("UTC")
        else:
            base["time"] = base["time"].dt.tz_convert("UTC")
    else:
        base["time"] = pd.to_datetime(base["time"], utc=True)

    # clip do okna czasowego
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=keep_days + 1)
    base = base[base["time"] >= pd.Timestamp(cutoff)].reset_index(drop=True)
    return base


def fetch_bars_incremental(symbol, timeframe, keep_days: int, update_days: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Strategia:
      • Gdy brak pliku – zbierz historię 'od końca' (copy_rates_from_pos) w 1–8 chunkach,
        aż pokryjesz ~keep_days (z marginesem). Jeśli to się nie uda – spróbuj krótszego range.
      • Gdy plik istnieje – dociągnij ostatnie update_days (mały range z fallbackiem).
    """
    existing = load_existing_bars(BARS_CSV)

    if existing is None:
        wanted_days = keep_days + 2
        parts_df = None
        # 1–8 prób z narastającą liczbą świec (od końca)
        for i in range(1, 9):  # zwiększone do 8 prób
            count = CHUNK * i
            try:
                dft = with_retries(lambda: fetch_from_pos_tail(symbol, timeframe, count))
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(1.0)
                continue
            if dft is not None and len(dft) > 0:
                parts_df = dft
                span_days = (parts_df["time"].max() - parts_df["time"].min()).days
                print(f"[backfill] try={i} count={count} rows={len(parts_df)} span_days={span_days}")
                if span_days >= wanted_days:
                    break

        if parts_df is None or parts_df.empty:
            # Ostatnia próba – krótszy range (np. 120 dni)
            to = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            frm = to - timedelta(days=min(120, wanted_days))
            parts_df = fetch_range(symbol, timeframe, frm, to)

        # Informacja: broker ograniczył backfill?
        try:
            final_span = (parts_df["time"].max() - parts_df["time"].min()).days if (parts_df is not None and len(parts_df) > 0) else 0
        except Exception:
            final_span = 0
        if final_span < keep_days - 5:
            print(f"[warn] broker backfill limited: span_days={final_span} < keep_days={keep_days}")

        return merge_clip(None, parts_df, keep_days)

    # Inkrementalnie: dociągnij update_days (mały range z fallbackiem)
    to = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    frm = to - timedelta(days=max(2, update_days))
    fresh = fetch_range(symbol, timeframe, frm, to)
    merged = merge_clip(existing, fresh, keep_days)
    return merged


def fetch_ticks(symbol: str, hours: int = 24) -> pd.DataFrame:
    utc_to = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    utc_from = utc_to - timedelta(hours=hours)
    ticks = mt5.copy_ticks_range(symbol, utc_from, utc_to, mt5.COPY_TICKS_ALL)
    if ticks is None or len(ticks) == 0:
        last_err = mt5.last_error()
        raise RuntimeError(f"No MT5 ticks for '{symbol}'. last_error={last_err}")
    tdf = pd.DataFrame(ticks)
    tdf["time"] = pd.to_datetime(tdf["time"], unit="s", utc=True)
    return tdf[["time", "bid", "ask", "last", "volume"]]


def suggest_costs(tdf: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    """Sugeruj koszty na bazie ticków: median/p75 spread, heurystyczny slippage_k."""
    spr = (
        tdf["ask"] - tdf["bid"]
    ).astype(float).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    med_spread = float(np.median(spr)) if len(spr) else 0.0
    p75_spread = float(np.percentile(spr, 75)) if len(spr) else 0.0
    mid = (tdf["ask"] + tdf["bid"]) / 2.0
    dm = (mid.diff().abs()).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
    med_dm = float(np.median(dm)) if len(dm) else 0.0
    med_price = float(np.nanmedian(mid)) if len(mid) else 1.0
    # heurystyka: jaką część typowego ruchu stanowi przeciętny skok mida
    slippage_k = float(min(max(med_dm / max(med_price, 1e-12), 0.0), 0.01))
    return {
        "spread_abs_median": round(med_spread, 5),
        "spread_abs_p75": round(p75_spread, 5),
        "slippage_k_suggested": round(slippage_k, 4),
    }


# ============================================================
# Main
# ============================================================
def main():
    init_mt5()
    try:
        print(f"[CFG] symbol={SYMBOL} tf={TF_NAME} keep_days={HISTORY_DAYS} update_days={UPDATE_DAYS}")

        if not ensure_symbol(SYMBOL):
            similar = suggest_similar(SYMBOL)
            hint = ", ".join(similar) if similar else "(brak propozycji)"
            raise SystemExit(
                "Symbol not found or not visible in Market Watch: '{}'\n"
                "Try one of these (server-specific): {}\n"
                "Also open Symbols window and SHOW the instrument."
                .format(SYMBOL, hint)
            )

        # ŚWIECE
        bars = fetch_bars_incremental(SYMBOL, TF, keep_days=HISTORY_DAYS, update_days=UPDATE_DAYS)
        assert {"time", "open", "high", "low", "close"}.issubset(bars.columns), "Bars frame malformed"
        assert len(bars) > 100, "Too few bars"
        atomic_write_csv(bars, BARS_CSV)
        print(f"Saved bars: {BARS_CSV} ({len(bars)})")

        # TICKI (opcjonalnie; weekend-safe)
        try:
            ticks = with_retries(lambda: fetch_ticks(SYMBOL, hours=24))
            atomic_write_csv(ticks, TICKS_CSV)
            print(f"Saved ticks: {TICKS_CSV} ({len(ticks)})")
            sugg = suggest_costs(ticks)
            rep = Path("reports"); rep.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            Path("reports/costs_suggestion.yaml").write_text(
                yaml.safe_dump(sugg, allow_unicode=True, sort_keys=False),
                encoding="utf-8"
            )
            print("Cost suggestions -> reports/costs_suggestion.yaml")
        except Exception as e:
            # np. weekend: brak ticków (OK)
            print(f"[warn] ticks unavailable ({e}); keeping previous {TICKS_CSV}")

    finally:
        mt5.shutdown()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# C:\xau_rl\manually.py
import MetaTrader5 as mt5
from pprint import pprint

# 1) Połączenie (jeśli masz kilka MT5, odkomentuj 'path=' i wskaż właściwy terminal64.exe)
# mt5.initialize(path=r"C:\Program Files\TwójBroker\terminal64.exe")
mt5.initialize(path=r"C:\Program Files\MetaTrader 5\terminal64.exe")

# 2) Diagnostyka środowiska
ti = mt5.terminal_info()
ai = mt5.account_info()
print("== terminal_info ==");  pprint(ti._asdict() if hasattr(ti,"_asdict") else ti)
print("== account_info  ==");  pprint(ai._asdict() if hasattr(ai,"_asdict") else ai)

# 3) Prosty smoke: market BUY 0.01
symbol = "GOLD.pro"
tick   = mt5.symbol_info_tick(symbol)
if tick is None:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Brak ticka dla {symbol} (symbol niewidoczny w MarketWatch?).")

request = {
    "action": mt5.TRADE_ACTION_DEAL,
    "symbol": symbol,
    "volume": 0.01,
    "type": mt5.ORDER_TYPE_BUY,
    "price": tick.ask,
    "deviation": 20,
    "magic": 123456,
    "comment": "smoke",
    "type_time": mt5.ORDER_TIME_GTC,
    "type_filling": mt5.ORDER_FILLING_RETURN,  # jeśli broker nie akceptuje -> fallback poniżej
}

res = mt5.order_send(request)
if res and getattr(res, "retcode", None) == 10030:  # INVALID_FILL -> spróbuj FOK
    request["type_filling"] = mt5.ORDER_FILLING_FOK
    res = mt5.order_send(request)

print("== order_send result ==")
pprint(res._asdict() if hasattr(res, "_asdict") else res)
print("retcode:", getattr(res, "retcode", None))

mt5.shutdown()

### FILE: merge_repo.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

"""
Zbiera pliki z repozytorium do jednego pliku .txt:
- wypisuje listę plików (z rozmiarem i opcjonalnym SHA256),
- dołącza treść TYLKO plików tekstowych,
- archiwa (np. .zip/.rar/.7z/.tar/.gz) oraz inne binaria są zawsze BEZ treści,
- posiada rozsądne ignorowanie katalogów i możliwość sterowania filtrami.

Użycie (najprostsze):
    python collect_repo_to_txt.py --root . --output repo_dump.txt

Przykłady:
    # Większy limit pliku i wymuszenie włączenia .py i .ps1
    python collect_repo_to_txt.py --max-size 10000000 --include-ext .py,.ps1

    # Z własną listą ignorowanych katalogów
    python collect_repo_to_txt.py --ignore-dirs .git,venv,node_modules,dist,build,__pycache__

    # Tylko z wybranych katalogów
    python collect_repo_to_txt.py --only-dirs src,scripts

    # Dla PowerShelli w UTF-16
    python collect_repo_to_txt.py --encoding utf-16
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import sys

SEPARATOR = "=" * 80

DEFAULT_IGNORE_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".idea", ".vscode",
    "node_modules", "dist", "build", "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache",
    "venv", ".venv", "env", ".mypy_cache", ".ruff_cache", ".cache",
    ".terraform", ".tox", ".gradle", "target", ".next", ".nuxt", ".parcel-cache"
}

# Rozszerzenia archiwów – nigdy nie czytamy zawartości:
ARCHIVE_EXTS = {
    ".zip", ".rar", ".7z", ".tar", ".gz", ".tgz", ".bz2", ".xz", ".zst"
}

# Pliki zwykle binarne – nie czytamy treści:
DEFAULT_BINARY_EXTS = set(ARCHIVE_EXTS) | {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".bmp", ".ico", ".tiff", ".webp",
    ".pdf", ".mp3", ".wav", ".flac", ".mp4", ".mkv", ".mov", ".avi",
    ".exe", ".dll", ".so", ".dylib", ".bin", ".class", ".o", ".a",
    ".woff", ".woff2", ".eot", ".ttf", ".otf", ".psd", ".ai",
}

# Rozszerzenia zwykle tekstowe – próbujemy czytać:
LIKELY_TEXT_EXTS = {
    ".txt", ".md", ".rst", ".py", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx",
    ".json", ".yml", ".yaml", ".toml", ".ini", ".cfg", ".conf",
    ".css", ".scss", ".sass", ".less", ".html", ".htm", ".xml",
    ".gradle", ".properties", ".sh", ".bat", ".ps1", ".psm1", ".psd1", ".sql",
    ".dockerfile", "dockerfile", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
    ".tf", ".tfvars", ".pl", ".rb", ".go", ".java", ".kt", ".scala",
    ".c", ".h", ".hpp", ".hh", ".cpp", ".cc", ".cs", ".rs", ".lua",
    ".ipynb"  # to JSON; bywa duże – rozmiar limituje dołączenie
}

def parse_comma_list(value: str):
    return [x.strip() for x in value.split(",") if x.strip()]

def compute_sha256(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def try_read_text(path, preferred_encoding="utf-8"):
    """
    Próbuje odczytać plik jako tekst testując kilka popularnych kodowań,
    w tym UTF-16 dla PowerShell.
    """
    encodings = [
        preferred_encoding,
        "utf-8", "utf-8-sig",
        "utf-16-le", "utf-16",
        "latin-1", "cp1250", "cp1252"
    ]
    for enc in encodings:
        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding=enc, errors="strict") as f:
                return f.read(), enc
        except Exception:
            continue
    # Fallback – zezwól na zamiany znaków
    for enc in ["utf-8", "utf-16-le", "utf-16", "latin-1"]:
        try:
            with open(path, "r", encoding=enc, errors="replace") as f:
                return f.read(), enc + " (replace)"
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None, None

def looks_like_text(path):
    name = os.path.basename(path).lower()
    ext = os.path.splitext(name)[1]
    if name == "dockerfile":
        return True
    if ext in LIKELY_TEXT_EXTS:
        return True
    return False

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Zbiera repo do jednego pliku .txt (bez środka ZIP/archiwów).")
    parser.add_argument("--root", default=".", help="Katalog repo (domyślnie .)")
    parser.add_argument("--output", default="repo_dump.txt", help="Plik wynikowy .txt")
    parser.add_argument("--max-size", type=int, default=2_000_000,
                        help="Maksymalny rozmiar pojedynczego pliku do włączenia treści (domyślnie 2MB)")
    parser.add_argument("--include-ext", default="",
                        help="Wymuś włączenie treści tych rozszerzeń (comma-separated), np. .py,.ps1")
    parser.add_argument("--exclude-ext", default="",
                        help="Wyklucz te rozszerzenia (comma-separated) – nadpisuje domyślne")
    parser.add_argument("--ignore-dirs", default="",
                        help="Dodatkowe katalogi do ignorowania (comma-separated)")
    parser.add_argument("--only-dirs", default="",
                        help="Jeśli podane, przetwarzaj tylko te podkatalogi względem --root (comma-separated)")
    parser.add_argument("--no-hash", action="store_true", help="Nie licz SHA256 (szybciej)")
    parser.add_argument("--encoding", default="utf-8", help="Preferowane kodowanie do odczytu tekstu")
    parser.add_argument("--archives-as-binary", action="store_true", default=True,
                        help="Traktuj archiwa jako binarne (domyślnie WŁĄCZONE)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = os.path.abspath(args.root)
    output = os.path.abspath(args.output)

    include_exts = set(e.lower() for e in parse_comma_list(args.include_ext))
    extra_exclude_exts = set(e.lower() for e in parse_comma_list(args.exclude_ext))

    user_ignore_dirs = set(parse_comma_list(args.ignore_dirs))
    only_dirs = set(parse_comma_list(args.only_dirs))

    # Funkcje pomocnicze
    def path_in_only_dirs(dirpath):
        if not only_dirs:
            return True
        # Sprawdź czy ścieżka zaczyna się którymś z only_dirs względem root
        rel = os.path.relpath(dirpath, root)
        parts = [] if rel == "." else rel.split(os.sep)
        return parts and parts[0] in only_dirs

    def should_ignore_dir(dirpath):
        base = os.path.basename(dirpath)
        return base in DEFAULT_IGNORE_DIRS or base in user_ignore_dirs

    # Zbieranie plików
    files_info = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        # Filtr only-dirs na poziomie korzenia
        if os.path.abspath(dirpath) == root and only_dirs:
            # Zostaw tylko katalogi z listy
            dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d in only_dirs]

        # Ignoruj katalogi
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if not should_ignore_dir(os.path.join(dirpath, d))]
        # Jeśli ustawiono only_dirs, odrzuć ścieżki spoza nich
        if only_dirs and not path_in_only_dirs(dirpath):
            continue

        for fn in filenames:
            full = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
            if os.path.abspath(full) == output:
                continue
            try:
                rel = os.path.relpath(full, root)
            except ValueError:
                rel = full

            try:
                size = os.path.getsize(full)
            except OSError:
                size = -1

            ext = os.path.splitext(fn)[1].lower()
            is_archive = ext in ARCHIVE_EXTS if args.archives_as_binary else False
            is_binary_by_ext = is_archive or (ext in DEFAULT_BINARY_EXTS) or (ext in extra_exclude_exts)
            forced_include = ext in include_exts

            entry = {
                "rel": rel,
                "full": full,
                "size": size,
                "sha256": None if args.no_hash else "(pending)",
                "ext": ext,
                "is_archive": is_archive,
                "is_binary_by_ext": is_binary_by_ext,
                "forced_include": forced_include,
                "will_embed": False  # nadamy później
            }
            files_info.append(entry)

    # Hashowanie
    if not args.no_hash:
        for e in files_info:
            try:
                e["sha256"] = compute_sha256(e["full"])
            except Exception:
                e["sha256"] = "(error)"

    # Decyzja: które pliki mają mieć dołączoną treść
    for e in files_info:
        # Archiwa i binarne – nie włączamy
        if e["is_binary_by_ext"]:
            e["will_embed"] = False
            continue
        # Limit rozmiaru
        if e["size"] >= 0 and e["size"] > args.max_size:
            e["will_embed"] = False
            continue
        # Wymuszenie
        if e["forced_include"]:
            e["will_embed"] = True
            continue
        # Heurystyka tekstowa + szybki test binarności
        if looks_like_text(e["full"]):
            e["will_embed"] = True
        else:
            try:
                with open(e["full"], "rb") as f:
                    chunk = f.read(4096)
                if b"\x00" in chunk:
                    e["will_embed"] = False
                else:
                    # Spróbujmy zdekodować chunk preferowanym kodowaniem
                    try:
                        chunk.decode(args.encoding)
                        e["will_embed"] = True
                    except Exception:
                        e["will_embed"] = False
            except Exception:
                e["will_embed"] = False

    # Zapis do wyjścia
    with open(output, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as out:
        out.write(f"# Repo dump (bez środka archiwów)\n")
        out.write(f"# Root: {root}\n")
        out.write(f"# Maks. rozmiar treści: {args.max_size} B\n")
        out.write(f"# Preferowane kodowanie: {args.encoding}\n")
        out.write(f"# Archiwa jako binarne: {'TAK' if args.archives_as_binary else 'NIE'}\n")
        out.write(f"{SEPARATOR}\n\n")

        out.write("## Spis plików:\n\n")
        for e in sorted(files_info, key=lambda x: x["rel"].lower()):
            size_s = f"{e['size']} B" if e["size"] >= 0 else "unknown"
            hash_s = e["sha256"] if e["sha256"] is not None else "(hash off)"
            if e["is_archive"]:
                kind = "ARCHIVE/OMIT"
            else:
                kind = "TEXT" if e["will_embed"] else ("BINARY/OMIT" if e["is_binary_by_ext"] else "OMIT")
            out.write(f"- {e['rel']}  | {size_s} | {kind} | sha256={hash_s}\n")

        out.write(f"\n{SEPARATOR}\n")
        out.write("## Treść plików tekstowych:\n\n")

        for e in sorted(files_info, key=lambda x: x["rel"].lower()):
            if not e["will_embed"]:
                continue
            out.write(f"{SEPARATOR}\n")
            out.write(f"### FILE: {e['rel']}\n")
            out.write(f"# SIZE: {e['size']} B | sha256: {e['sha256'] if e['sha256'] else '(hash off)'}\n")
            out.write(f"{SEPARATOR}\n")
            text, used_enc = try_read_text(e["full"], preferred_encoding=args.encoding)
            if text is None:
                out.write(f"[UWAGA] Nie udało się bezpiecznie odczytać jako tekst.\n\n")
            else:
                if used_enc and used_enc != "utf-8":
                    out.write(f"[INFO] Odczytano w kodowaniu: {used_enc}\n\n")
                out.write(text)
                if not text.endswith("\n"):
                    out.write("\n")
            out.write("\n")

        out.write(f"{SEPARATOR}\n")
        out.write("## Koniec\n")

    total = len(files_info)
    embedded = sum(1 for e in files_info if e["will_embed"])
    omitted_bin = sum(1 for e in files_info if e["is_binary_by_ext"])
    archives = sum(1 for e in files_info if e["is_archive"])
    print(f"Zapisano: {output}")
    print(f"Plików ogółem: {total} | Tekst dołączony: {embedded} | Binarne pominięte: {omitted_bin} | Archiwa: {archives}")
    print("Jeśli wynik wyszedł za duży, zmniejsz --max-size lub rozbuduj --exclude-ext.")
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

### FILE: ops\daemon_calibration_biweekly.ps1
# SIZE: 1549 B | sha256: 8e1b23144f96af5f1469bf63eff7ef6e36a98086d712dab40f84822c8b2380f0

﻿$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$REPO="C:\xau_rl"; $PY="$REPO\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$LOG="$REPO\logs\services\calibration_3d.log"; $LOCK="$REPO\logs\services\calibration_3d.lock"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $LOG) | Out-Null; Set-Location $REPO
if(-not (Test-Path $LOG) -or (Get-Item $LOG).Length -eq 0){
  "[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [calibration] bootstrap_alive" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
}
function Acquire-Lock { if(Test-Path $LOCK){$false}else{New-Item -ItemType File -Path $LOCK -Force|Out-Null;$true} }
function Release-Lock { if(Test-Path $LOCK){Remove-Item $LOCK -Force} }
function Run-Once { & $PY "utils\calibration.py" "--apply" *>> $LOG }
function Seconds-To-Next-22 {
  $now = Get-Date
  $target = [DateTime]::Today.AddHours(22)
  if ($now -ge $target) { $target = $target.AddDays(1) }
  $diff = $target - $now
  return ([int]$diff.TotalSeconds)
}
while($true){
  Start-Sleep -Seconds (Seconds-To-Next-22)
  $ts=Get-Date -Format o
  try{
    if(Acquire-Lock){
      "`n[$ts] [calibration] start" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
      Run-Once
      "`n[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [calibration] done" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
      Release-Lock
    } else {
      "`n[$ts] [calibration] skipped (locked)" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
    }
  } catch {
    "[ERROR] $($_|Out-String)" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
    Release-Lock
  }
  Start-Sleep -Seconds (24*3600 - 60)
}

### FILE: ops\daemon_cleanup.ps1
# SIZE: 3311 B | sha256: 833a65bf268bbae93181347cbc1d05292705447362d0e5f2ebbfee81bdeaf504
================================================================================
﻿# encoding: utf-8
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# === PARAMETRY Z ENV (z domyślnymi wartościami) ===
# Repo root
$REPO = $env:XAU_REPO
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($REPO)) { $REPO = "C:\xau_rl" }

# Jeśli ktoś podał AppEnvironmentExtra w jednej linii (ze średnikami),
# utnij wszystko po pierwszym ';' – defensywna sanitacja.
if ($REPO -like "*;*") {
    $REPO = $REPO.Split(';')[0]
}

# Ścieżki
$PPO_DIR  = Join-Path $REPO "logs\ppo_gold_m5"
$SERV_DIR = Join-Path $REPO "logs\services"
$MODELS   = Join-Path $REPO "models"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $MODELS | Out-Null

# Liczby z ENV (PS 5.1 – bez operatora ?:)
[int]$KEEP_FOLDERS = 10
if ($env:KEEP_PPO -and $env:KEEP_PPO -match '^\d+$') {
    $KEEP_FOLDERS = [int]$env:KEEP_PPO
}

[int]$KEEP_LOG_DAYS = 30
if ($env:KEEP_LOG_DAYS -and $env:KEEP_LOG_DAYS -match '^\d+$') {
    $KEEP_LOG_DAYS = [int]$env:KEEP_LOG_DAYS
}

[int]$INTERVAL_H = 24
if ($env:CLEANUP_INTERVAL_HOURS -and $env:CLEANUP_INTERVAL_HOURS -match '^\d+$') {
    $INTERVAL_H = [int]$env:CLEANUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
}

function Log([string]$m) {
    $ts = Get-Date -Format o
    Write-Host "[$ts] [cleanup] $m"
}

function Cleanup-PPOFolders {
    Log "Czyszczenie folderów PPO ($PPO_DIR) – zachowuję $KEEP_FOLDERS"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $PPO_DIR)) { return }

    $folders  = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $PPO_DIR -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
                Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
    if (-not $folders) { return }

    $toRemove = $folders | Select-Object -Skip $KEEP_FOLDERS
    foreach ($f in $toRemove) {
        try {
            # (opcjonalnie) kopia best_model.zip przed usunięciem katalogu
            $best = Join-Path $f.FullName "best_model.zip"
            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $best) {
                $dest = Join-Path $MODELS ("best_" + $f.Name + ".zip")
                Copy-Item -LiteralPath $best -Destination $dest -Force
                Log "Zapisano kopię modelu: $dest"
            }

            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Recurse -Force
            Log "Usunięto folder: $($f.Name)"
        }
        catch {
            Log "Błąd usuwania $($f.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

function Cleanup-ServiceLogs {
    Log "Czyszczenie logów usług starszych niż $KEEP_LOG_DAYS dni ($SERV_DIR)"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SERV_DIR)) { return }

    $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$KEEP_LOG_DAYS)

    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $SERV_DIR -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
        Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff } |
        ForEach-Object {
            try {
                Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Force
                Log "Usunięto log: $($_.Name)"
            }
            catch {
                Log "Błąd usuwania logu $($_.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
            }
        }
}

# --- Pętla główna (co $INTERVAL_H godzin) ---
while ($true) {
    try {
        Log "Start cleanup"
        Cleanup-PPOFolders
        Cleanup-ServiceLogs
        Log "Cleanup zakończony"
    }
    catch {
        Log "Błąd cleanup: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }

    Start-Sleep -Seconds ($INTERVAL_H * 3600)
}

### FILE: ops\daemon_feature_discovery.ps1
# SIZE: 2980 B | sha256: b03f84d904fbf3e0a1db4cced811899640308f13a38ff34a682afb9499a9d671
================================================================================
﻿$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$REPO = "C:\xau_rl"; $PY = "$REPO\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$LOG  = "$REPO\logs\services\feature_discovery.log"
$LOCK = "$REPO\logs\services\feature_discovery.lock"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $LOG) | Out-Null
Set-Location $REPO

if (-not (Test-Path $LOG) -or (Get-Item $LOG).Length -eq 0) {
    "[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [feature_discovery] bootstrap_alive" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
}

function Acquire-Lock { if (Test-Path $LOCK) { $false } else { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $LOCK -Force | Out-Null; $true } }
function Release-Lock { if (Test-Path $LOCK) { Remove-Item $LOCK -Force } }

function Rotate-Log { param([string]$Path, [int]$MaxMB = 50, [int]$Keep = 5)
    if (Test-Path $Path) {
        $sizeMB = [Math]::Round((Get-Item $Path).Length / 1MB)
        if ($sizeMB -ge $MaxMB) {
            for ($i = $Keep - 1; $i -ge 1; $i--) {
                $src = "$Path.$i"; $dst = "$Path." + ($i + 1)
                if (Test-Path $src) { Move-Item -Force $src $dst }
            }
            Move-Item -Force $Path "$Path.1"
            "" | Out-File -FilePath $Path -Encoding utf8
        }
    }
}

function Seconds-To-Next-21 {
    $now = Get-Date
    $target = [DateTime]::Today.AddHours(21)
    if ($now -ge $target) { $target = $target.AddDays(1) }
    $diff = $target - $now
    return ([int]$diff.TotalSeconds)
}

function Run-Once {
    Rotate-Log -Path $LOG -MaxMB 50 -Keep 5
    & $PY "ops\feature_discovery_weekly.py" `
        "--topK" "96" `
        "--max_lag" "3" `
        "--change_frac" "0.10" `
        "--mode" "update-spec" `
        "--min_jaccard" "0.75" `
        "--live-only" `
        *>> $LOG
    $exit = $LASTEXITCODE
    "[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [feature_discovery] exit_code=$exit" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8

    $specLive = Join-Path $REPO "models\features_spec_live.json"
    if (Test-Path $specLive) {
        $ageMin = (New-TimeSpan -Start (Get-Item $specLive).LastWriteTime -End (Get-Date)).TotalMinutes
        "[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [feature_discovery] spec_live_age_min={0:N1}" -f $ageMin |
            Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
    }
}

while ($true) {
    Start-Sleep -Seconds (Seconds-To-Next-21)
    $ts = Get-Date -Format o
    try {
        if (Acquire-Lock) {
            "`n[$ts] [feature_discovery] start" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
            Run-Once
            "`n[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [feature_discovery] done" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
            Release-Lock
        } else {
            "`n[$ts] [feature_discovery] skipped (locked)" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
        }
    } catch {
        "[ERROR] $($_ | Out-String)" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
        Release-Lock
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds (24*3600 - 60)
}

# --- Jednorazowe wykonanie całego pipeline'u ---
function Run-Once {

  # Diagnostyka przed uruchomieniem (przydatne przy debugowaniu ścieżek)
  "CWD: $(Get-Location)"                                   | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists rl\train_ppo.py: $(Test-Path 'rl\train_ppo.py')" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists rl\evaluate.py: $(Test-Path 'rl\evaluate.py')"   | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists utils\make_report.py: $(Test-Path 'utils\make_report.py')" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists ops\guard_spec_quality.py: $(Test-Path 'ops\guard_spec_quality.py')" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists ops\save_candidate.py: $(Test-Path 'ops\save_candidate.py')" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists ops\promote_challenger.py: $(Test-Path 'ops\promote_challenger.py')" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
  "Exists config.yaml: $(Test-Path 'config.yaml')"         | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8

  # --- 1) Trening nocny ---
  & $PY -u "rl\train_ppo.py" "--timesteps" "1500000" *>> $LOG

  # --- 2) Ewaluacja ---
  & $PY -u "rl\evaluate.py" "--out_dir" "reports" *>> $LOG

  # --- 3) Raport (ze znacznikiem czasu + korekta bars_per_day jeśli handlujesz <24h/d) ---
  & $PY -u "utils\make_report.py" "--stamp" "--bars_per_day" "216" *>> $LOG

  # --- 4) Strażnik jakości speca (rollback & failed-candidate on bad metrics) ---
  & $PY -u "ops\guard_spec_quality.py" "--bars_per_day" "216" "--min_sharpe" "0.30" "--min_calmar" "0.20" "--max_sharpe_drop" "0.35" "--max_calmar_drop" "0.50" *>> $LOG
  $guard_code = $LASTEXITCODE
  "guard_spec_quality exit=$guard_code" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8

  if ($guard_code -eq 2) {
    # FAIL-CANDIDATE -> NIE zapisuj i NIE promuj
    "[$(Get-Date -Format o)] [nightly_train] candidate FAILED -> skip save/promote" | Out-File -FilePath $LOG -Append -Encoding utf8
    return
  }

  # --- 5) Zapis i promocja kandydata (tylko jeśli guard OK) ---
  & $PY -u "ops\save_candidate.py"     *>> $LOG
  & $PY -u "ops\promote_challenger.py" *>> $LOG
}

# --- Funkcja wyliczająca ile spać do 00:30 następnego wystąpienia ---
function Seconds-To-Next-0030 {
  $now    = Get-Date
  $target = [DateTime]::Today.AddHours(0).AddMinutes(30)
  if ($now -ge $target) { $target = $target.AddDays(1) }
  $diff = $target - $now
  return ([int]$diff.TotalSeconds)
}

# ops/feature_discovery_weekly.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Feature Discovery (XAUUSD M5)
- Ranking cech (Spearman vs target), lagi blokowo (--max_lag),
- Dywersyfikacja vs historia (--change_frac => MIN_NEW_RATIO), repeat-penalty,
- Wyjścia:
  * models/features_spec.json (gdy --mode update-spec i Jaccard spadnie poniżej progu),
  * models/features_spec_live.json (LIVE-SAFE = intersekcja z tym, co potrafi pętla LIVE),
  * models/features_spec_history.jsonl (append, historia zmian),
  * reports/feature_discovery_rank.csv,
  * reports/feature_discovery_summary.txt,
  * reports/feature_discovery_report.html (KEPT / NEW / REMOVED).
"""

import argparse
import os
import json
import traceback
import html
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import yaml

# Repo root (plik jest w katalogu ops/)
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
os.chdir(ROOT)

# Ścieżki wyjściowe
LOG_DIR = ROOT / "logs"
LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
LOG = LOG_DIR / "feature_discovery.log"

HIST_PATH = ROOT / "models" / "features_spec_history.jsonl"
SPEC_PATH = ROOT / "models" / "features_spec.json"
SPEC_LIVE = ROOT / "models" / "features_spec_live.json"

RANK_PATH = ROOT / "reports" / "feature_discovery_rank.csv"
SUMMARY_P = ROOT / "reports" / "feature_discovery_summary.txt"
HTML_P = ROOT / "reports" / "feature_discovery_report.html"

# Parametry stałe
MIN_NEW_RATIO = 0.20       # domyślny udział nowych cech w topK (może być nadpisany --change_frac)
HIST_WINDOW = 6            # ile ostatnich wpisów historii użyć do repeat-penalty
REPEAT_PENALTY = 0.90      # współczynnik kary za częste powtarzanie tej samej cechy
MIN_OBS = 200              # minimalna liczba obserwacji do oceny korelacji

# Placeholder — niewykorzystywany w tej wersji, ale zostawiamy dla spójności repo
FRED_API_KEY_HARDCODED = os.environ.get("FRED_API_KEY", "")


def log(msg: str):
    ts = datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with LOG.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(f"[{ts}] {msg}\n")


def load_cfg():
    return yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "config.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def read_features_csv(cfg):
    p = Path(cfg["files"]["features_csv"])
    if not p.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"features_csv not found: {p}")
    df = pd.read_csv(p, parse_dates=["time"])
    return df.sort_values("time").reset_index(drop=True)


def build_target(df: pd.DataFrame, price_col="close", horizon=1):
    """Target = jednokrokowa przyszła zmiana procentowa."""
    return df[price_col].pct_change().shift(-horizon).rename("target_fwd1")


def add_lags(df: pd.DataFrame, cols: list, max_lag: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Dodaje lagi 1..max_lag dla listy kolumn."""
    if max_lag <= 0 or not cols:
        return df
    lag_blocks = []
    for L in range(1, max_lag + 1):
        blk = df[cols].shift(L)
        blk.columns = [f"{c}_lag{L}" for c in cols]
        lag_blocks.append(blk)
    return pd.concat([df] + lag_blocks, axis=1, copy=False)


def score_features(df: pd.DataFrame, feature_cols: list, target_col="target_fwd1"):
    """Ranking po |Spearman|. Pomija cechy zbyt stałe i zbyt krótkie."""
    scores = []
    y_full = df[target_col].astype(float)
    for c in feature_cols:
        try:
            x_full = df[c].astype(float)
            ok = x_full.notna() & y_full.notna()
            n = int(ok.sum())
            if n < MIN_OBS:
                continue
            x = x_full[ok]
            y = y_full[ok]
            if x.nunique(dropna=True) <= 1 or y.nunique(dropna=True) <= 1:
                continue
            rho = x.corr(y, method="spearman")
            if pd.notna(rho):
                scores.append((c, float(abs(rho))))
        except Exception:
            # bezpiecznie pomijamy pojedyncze problemy kolumn
            continue
    scores.sort(key=lambda t: t[1], reverse=True)
    return pd.DataFrame(scores, columns=["feature", "abs_spearman"])


def load_history(max_lines=HIST_WINDOW):
    if not HIST_PATH.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for line in HIST_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        try:
            rows.append(json.loads(line))
        except Exception:
            pass
    return rows[-max_lines:] if rows else []


def save_history(entry: dict):
    HIST_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with HIST_PATH.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def jaccard(a: set, b: set) -> float:
    """|A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B| z ochroną przed dzieleniem przez 0."""
    if not a and not b:
        return 1.0
    return len(a & b) / max(1, len(a | b))


def apply_repeat_penalty(rank_df: pd.DataFrame, hist_rows: list):
    """Obniża punktację cechom często wybieranym w poprzednich tygodniach."""
    if not hist_rows or rank_df.empty:
        return rank_df.copy()
    freq = {}
    for r in hist_rows:
        for c in r.get("feature_columns", []):
            freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1
    out = rank_df.copy()
    out["repeat_freq"] = out["feature"].map(lambda c: freq.get(c, 0))
    out["score_after_penalty"] = out["abs_spearman"] * (REPEAT_PENALTY ** out["repeat_freq"])
    return out.sort_values("score_after_penalty", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)


def diversify_select(adjusted_rank: pd.DataFrame, prev_features: list, topK: int,
                     min_new_ratio=MIN_NEW_RATIO):
    """Wymusza min. udział nowych cech w topK, resztę dopełnia z rankingu."""
    prev_set = set(prev_features or [])
    new_needed = int(np.ceil(topK * min_new_ratio))
    chosen, new_cnt = [], 0
    # Najpierw nowe
    for _, row in adjusted_rank.iterrows():
        f = row["feature"]
        if f not in prev_set and f not in chosen:
            chosen.append(f)
            new_cnt += 1
            if new_cnt >= new_needed:
                break
    # Potem dopełnienie
    if len(chosen) < topK:
        for _, row in adjusted_rank.iterrows():
            f = row["feature"]
            if f not in chosen:
                chosen.append(f)
                if len(chosen) >= topK:
                    break
    return chosen[:topK]


def features_hash(features: list) -> str:
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha1(",".join(sorted(features or [])).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]


def render_changes_html(kept, new, removed, jac, topK, spec_id, rank_csv_rel):
    def lst(title, items, color):
        items = list(items)
        cnt = len(items)
        lis = "".join(f"<li><code>{html.escape(x)}</code></li>" for x in items)
        body = f"<ul>{lis}</ul>"
        det = (f"<details{' open' if cnt <= 50 else ''}>"
               f"<summary>{title} ({cnt})</summary>{body}</details>")
        return f"<div style='margin:10px 0;color:{color}'>{det}</div>"
    return f"""<!doctype html><html lang="pl"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Feature Discovery — zmiany cech</title>
<style>body{{font-family:Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;margin:24px;color:#222}}
h1{{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 8px}}
.meta{{color:#666;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:12px}}
.box{{background:#fafafa;border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin:12px 0}}
code{{background:#f2f2f2;padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px}}
a{{color:#0057B8}}</style></head>
<body>
  <h1>Feature Discovery — raport zmian</h1>
  <div class="meta">Spec ID: <code>{spec_id}</code>
  TopK: {topK}
  Jaccard(prev,cur): {jac:.3f}</div>
  <div class="box"><p><strong>Ranking CSV:</strong> {html.escape(rank_csv_rel)}{html.escape(rank_csv_rel)}</a></p></div>
  <div class="box">{lst("Utrzymane", kept, "#2b7a0b")}</div>
  <div class="box">{lst("Nowe", new, "#1f5fbf")}</div>
  <div class="box">{lst("Usunięte", removed, "#b3261e")}</div>
</body></html>"""


# --- wszechświat cech dostępnych w pętli LIVE (add_features_incremental + lagi) ---
LIVE_BASE = [
    "ret1", "ema10", "ema50", "ema200", "rsi14", "atr14",
    "macd", "macd_signal", "macd_hist",
    "bb_ma", "bb_up", "bb_lo", "bb_width",
    "close_log", "close_norm",
]


def live_feature_universe(max_lag: int):
    cols = set(LIVE_BASE)
    for L in range(1, max_lag + 1):
        for c in LIVE_BASE:
            cols.add(f"{c}_lag{L}")
    return cols


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--topK", type=int, default=96)
    ap.add_argument("--max_lag", type=int, default=3)
    ap.add_argument("--out", type=str, default=str(SPEC_PATH))
    ap.add_argument("--change_frac", type=float, default=None,
                    help="Minimalny udział nowych cech w topK (0..1). Domyślnie 0.20.")
    ap.add_argument("--mode", type=str, default="update-spec",
                    choices=["rank-only", "update-spec"],
                    help="'update-spec' zapisze features_spec.json gdy zmiana duża (Jaccard<min).")
    ap.add_argument("--min_jaccard", type=float, default=0.75,
                    help="Próg podobieństwa (Jaccard) do aktualizacji features_spec.json.")
    ap.add_argument("--live-only", action="store_true", default=True,
                    help="Rankuj i wybieraj tylko cechy dostępne w LIVE (LIVE_BASE + lagi).")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    global MIN_NEW_RATIO
    if args.change_frac is not None:
        MIN_NEW_RATIO = float(np.clip(args.change_frac, 0.0, 1.0))

    try:
        log("feature_discovery bootstrap_alive")

        cfg = load_cfg()
        df = read_features_csv(cfg)

        price_col = "close_norm" if "close_norm" in df.columns else "close"
        df["target_fwd1"] = build_target(df, price_col=price_col)

        # baza i kandydaci
        base_cols = ["time", "open", "high", "low", "close", "tick_volume", "spread"]
        all_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in base_cols + ["target_fwd1"]]

        # dobuduj lagi do wszystkich potencjalnych kandydatów
        df = add_lags(df, all_cols, args.max_lag)

        # ogranicz kandydatów w zależności od trybu
        if args.live_only:
            live_uni = live_feature_universe(args.max_lag)
            cand_cols = [c for c in df.columns
                         if (c not in base_cols + ["target_fwd1"]) and (c in live_uni)]
        else:
            cand_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in base_cols + ["target_fwd1"]]

        # ranking
        rank = score_features(df, cand_cols, target_col="target_fwd1")
        if rank.empty:
            raise RuntimeError("Ranking pusty – brak danych.")

        # historia + kara powtarzania
        hist = load_history(HIST_WINDOW)
        prev = hist[-1]["feature_columns"] if hist else []
        rank_adj = apply_repeat_penalty(rank, hist)

        # zapis CSV rankingu
        out_rank = rank_adj.assign(prev_used=lambda x: x["feature"].isin(prev))
        RANK_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        out_rank.to_csv(RANK_PATH, index=False)

        # wybór topK
        topK = max(int(args.topK), 8)
        chosen = diversify_select(rank_adj, prev, topK, MIN_NEW_RATIO)

        # metryki zmian
        prev_set, cur_set = set(prev or []), set(chosen or [])
        kept = sorted(cur_set & prev_set)
        new = sorted(cur_set - prev_set)
        removed = sorted(prev_set - cur_set)
        jac = jaccard(prev_set, cur_set)

        spec_id = features_hash(chosen)
        spec = {
            "feature_columns": chosen,
            "price_column": "close_norm" if "close_norm" in df.columns else "close",
            "generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "spec_id": spec_id,
            "max_lag": int(args.max_lag),
        }

        # raporty
        SUMMARY_P.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with SUMMARY_P.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write("# Feature Discovery Summary\n")
            f.write(f"Generated at: {datetime.now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}\n")
            f.write(f"TopK: {topK}\n")
            f.write(f"Prev size: {len(prev_set)}, Cur size: {len(cur_set)}\n")
            f.write(f"Jaccard(prev,cur): {jac:.3f}\n")
            f.write(f"Min new ratio enforced: {MIN_NEW_RATIO:.2f}\n\n-- KEPT --\n")
            for x in kept:
                f.write(f"{x}\n")
            f.write("\n-- NEW --\n")
            for x in new:
                f.write(f"{x}\n")
            f.write("\n-- REMOVED --\n")
            for x in removed:
                f.write(f"{x}\n")

        HTML_P.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        rank_rel = str(Path(os.path.relpath(RANK_PATH, HTML_P.parent)))
        HTML_P.write_text(
            render_changes_html(kept, new, removed, jac, topK, spec_id, rank_rel),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        # historia (zawsze)
        save_history({"ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                      "feature_columns": chosen, "spec_id": spec_id})

        # LIVE-SAFE
        live_universe = live_feature_universe(args.max_lag)
        live_safe = [c for c in chosen if c in live_universe]
        SPEC_LIVE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        SPEC_LIVE.write_text(json.dumps({
            "feature_columns": live_safe,
            "price_column": spec["price_column"],
            "generated_at": spec["generated_at"],
            "spec_id": spec_id + "_live",
            "max_lag": int(args.max_lag),
        }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

        # aktualizacja głównej spec (gdy zmiana jest istotna)
        allow_update = (args.mode == "update-spec") and (jac < float(args.min_jaccard))
        if allow_update:
            SPEC_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            SPEC_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(spec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            log(f"UPDATED spec -> {SPEC_PATH}, live -> {SPEC_LIVE}, "
                f"rank -> {RANK_PATH}, summary -> {SUMMARY_P}, html -> {HTML_P}")
            print("Feature discovery completed [UPDATE-SPEC].")
        else:
            log(f"SKIPPED spec update (mode={args.mode}, Jaccard={jac:.3f} >= {args.min_jaccard}); "
                f"live -> {SPEC_LIVE}")
            print("Feature discovery completed [RANK-ONLY].")

    except Exception as e:
        log(f"[ERROR] {e}")
        log(traceback.format_exc())
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ops/guard_spec_quality.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Strażnik jakości po nightly_train:
- Liczy Sharpe (dzienny) i Calmar z reports/eval_trace.csv,
- Porównuje z ostatnim championem (models/spec_scoreboard.jsonl),
- Przy dramatycznym spadku:
    * rollback models/features_spec.json do poprzedniego,
    * zapisuje wpis 'failed' w scoreboard,
    * kończy z kodem wyjścia 2 (aby daemon pominął save/promote).
- Przy OK: wpis 'accepted' (i opcjonalnie 'champion').

Użycie (przykład):
  python -u ops/guard_spec_quality.py --min_sharpe 0.30 --min_calmar 0.20 --max_sharpe_drop 0.35 --max_calmar_drop 0.50 --bars_per_day 216
"""

import argparse, json, sys, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

def features_hash(features):
    s = ",".join(sorted(features or []))
    return hashlib.sha1(s.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]

def load_current_spec(spec_path: Path):
    if not spec_path.exists():
        return None
    data = json.loads(spec_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    feats = data.get("feature_columns", [])
    return {"features": feats, "spec_id": data.get("spec_id") or features_hash(feats), "raw": data}

def compute_metrics(equity_csv: Path, bars_per_day: int, trading_days: int):
    if not equity_csv.exists():
        return None
    df = pd.read_csv(equity_csv)
    # equity column or single column
    if "equity" in df.columns:
        eq = df["equity"].astype(float).to_numpy()
    else:
        eq = df.iloc[:, 0].astype(float).to_numpy()
    if eq is None or len(eq) < 3:
        return None
    ret = np.diff(eq) / np.maximum(eq[:-1], 1e-12)
    mu = float(np.nanmean(ret))
    sigma = float(np.nanstd(ret) + 1e-12)
    downside = ret[ret < 0]
    ds = float(np.nanstd(downside) + 1e-12)

    daily_mu = mu * bars_per_day
    daily_sigma = sigma * (bars_per_day ** 0.5)
    sharpe = daily_mu / (daily_sigma + 1e-12)
    sortino = daily_mu / (((bars_per_day ** 0.5) * ds) + 1e-12)

    n = len(eq)
    years = max(n / bars_per_day / trading_days, 1e-6)
    cagr = (eq[-1] / max(eq[0], 1e-12)) ** (1 / years) - 1 if years > 0 else 0.0
    peak = np.maximum.accumulate(eq)
    max_dd = float((eq / peak - 1.0).min())
    calmar = (cagr / abs(max_dd)) if max_dd < 0 else float('inf')

    return dict(n_steps=n, sharpe=sharpe, sortino=sortino, vol_daily=daily_sigma, cagr=cagr, max_dd=max_dd, calmar=calmar)

def read_scoreboard(sb_path: Path):
    rows = []
    if sb_path.exists():
        with sb_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for line in f:
                try:
                    rows.append(json.loads(line))
                except:
                    pass
    return rows

def write_scoreboard(sb_path: Path, entry: dict):
    sb_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with sb_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

def last_accepted(rows):
    # ostatni wpis ze statusem 'accepted' lub 'champion'
    for r in reversed(rows):
        if r.get("status") in ("accepted","champion"):
            return r
    return None

def rollback_spec(current_spec_path: Path, hist_path: Path, target_spec_path: Path):
    # przywróć ostatni wpis z historii do current_spec_path
    if not hist_path.exists():
        return False
    lines = hist_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip().splitlines()
    if not lines:
        return False
    # szukamy wstecz ostatniego sensownego wpisu
    for line in reversed(lines):
        try:
            row = json.loads(line)
            feats = row.get("feature_columns", [])
            if feats:
                spec = {
                    "feature_columns": feats,
                    "price_column": "close",  # brak pewności -> zostaw default / pipeline i tak wczyta price_column z nowego speca gdy będzie
                    "generated_at": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                    "spec_id": features_hash(feats)
                }
                current_spec_path.write_text(json.dumps(spec, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
                # (opcjonalnie) zapis do pliku "rollback marker"
                target_spec_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                return True
        except:
            continue
    return False

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--equity_csv", type=str, default="reports/eval_trace.csv")
    ap.add_argument("--spec_path", type=str, default="models/features_spec.json")
    ap.add_argument("--history_path", type=str, default="models/features_spec_history.jsonl")
    ap.add_argument("--scoreboard", type=str, default="models/spec_scoreboard.jsonl")
    ap.add_argument("--bars_per_day", type=int, default=288)
    ap.add_argument("--trading_days", type=int, default=252)

    # progi minimalne (bezwzględne)
    ap.add_argument("--min_sharpe", type=float, default=0.30)
    ap.add_argument("--min_calmar", type=float, default=0.20)

    # progi względne (spadek vs champion)
    ap.add_argument("--max_sharpe_drop", type=float, default=0.35, help="Maksymalny dopuszczalny relatywny spadek Sharpe vs champion (np. 0.35 = -35%)")
    ap.add_argument("--max_calmar_drop", type=float, default=0.50, help="Maksymalny dopuszczalny relatywny spadek Calmar vs champion (np. 0.50 = -50%)")

    # czy aktualny bieg tworzy nowego championa po akceptacji
    ap.add_argument("--promote_if_better", action="store_true", help="Jeśli accepted i lepszy od championa -> oznacz jako 'champion'")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    equity_csv   = ROOT / args.equity_csv
    spec_path    = ROOT / args.spec_path
    history_path = ROOT / args.history_path
    sb_path      = ROOT / args.scoreboard

    # 1) wczytaj spec i metryki bieżącego kandydata
    cur_spec = load_current_spec(spec_path)
    if not cur_spec:
        print("[guard] no current features_spec.json -> nothing to guard; ACCEPT", flush=True)
        sys.exit(0)

    cur_metrics = compute_metrics(equity_csv, args.bars_per_day, args.trading_days)
    if not cur_metrics:
        print("[guard] no metrics computed (missing/too short eval_trace.csv) -> FAIL-CANDIDATE & ROLLBACK", flush=True)
        ok = rollback_spec(spec_path, history_path, spec_path)
        status = "failed"
        entry = {
            "ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "status": status,
            "reason": "metrics_unavailable",
            "spec_id": cur_spec["spec_id"],
            "feature_columns": cur_spec["features"],
            "metrics": cur_metrics
        }
        write_scoreboard(sb_path, entry)
        sys.exit(2)

    # 2) champion (ostatni zaakceptowany)
    rows = read_scoreboard(sb_path)
    prev = last_accepted(rows)

    # jeśli nie ma championa, akceptujemy pierwszy sensowny bieg
    if prev is None:
        write_scoreboard(sb_path, {
            "ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "status": "accepted",
            "spec_id": cur_spec["spec_id"],
            "feature_columns": cur_spec["features"],
            "metrics": cur_metrics
        })
        print("[guard] no champion -> ACCEPT first candidate", flush=True)
        sys.exit(0)

    prev_metrics = prev.get("metrics") or {}
    prev_sharpe  = float(prev_metrics.get("sharpe", 0.0))
    prev_calmar  = float(prev_metrics.get("calmar", 0.0))

    cur_sharpe   = float(cur_metrics.get("sharpe", 0.0))
    cur_calmar   = float(cur_metrics.get("calmar", 0.0))

    # 3) warunki odrzucenia
    reject = False
    reasons = []

    # progi bezwzględne
    if cur_sharpe < args.min_sharpe:
        reject = True; reasons.append(f"sharpe<{args.min_sharpe:.3f} ({cur_sharpe:.3f})")
    if (cur_calmar < args.min_calmar) and np.isfinite(cur_calmar):
        reject = True; reasons.append(f"calmar<{args.min_calmar:.3f} ({cur_calmar:.3f})")

    # progi względne vs champion (tylko jeśli champion ma sensowne metryki)
    if prev_sharpe > 0:
        rel_drop = (prev_sharpe - cur_sharpe) / max(1e-12, prev_sharpe)
        if rel_drop > args.max_sharpe_drop:
            reject = True; reasons.append(f"sharpe_drop>{args.max_sharpe_drop:.2f} ({rel_drop:.2f})")
    if prev_calmar > 0 and np.isfinite(prev_calmar):
        rel_drop = (prev_calmar - cur_calmar) / max(1e-12, prev_calmar)
        if rel_drop > args.max_calmar_drop:
            reject = True; reasons.append(f"calmar_drop>{args.max_calmar_drop:.2f} ({rel_drop:.2f})")

    if reject:
        # rollback do poprzedniego speca
        ok = rollback_spec(spec_path, history_path, spec_path)
        write_scoreboard(sb_path, {
            "ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "status": "failed",
            "reasons": reasons,
            "spec_id": cur_spec["spec_id"],
            "feature_columns": cur_spec["features"],
            "metrics": cur_metrics
        })
        print(f"[guard] FAILED-CANDIDATE -> rollback spec; reasons: {', '.join(reasons)}", flush=True)
        sys.exit(2)

    # jeśli accepted i (opcjonalnie) lepszy -> promuj jako champion
    status = "accepted"
    if args.promote_if_better:
        score_prev = (prev_sharpe + prev_calmar)  # prosty miks; możesz zmienić na ważony
        score_cur  = (cur_sharpe + cur_calmar)
        if score_cur > score_prev:
            status = "champion"

    write_scoreboard(sb_path, {
        "ts": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "status": status,
        "spec_id": cur_spec["spec_id"],
        "feature_columns": cur_spec["features"],
        "metrics": cur_metrics
    })
    print(f"[guard] {status.upper()} -> proceed", flush=True)
    sys.exit(0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

function PS-Host(){

    $p = "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe"
    if(Test-Path $p){ return $p }
    Warn "PS7 nie znaleziony. Używam klasycznego PowerShell."

function Get-PlainPassword([securestring]$sec, [string]$plain){
  if ($sec){
    $BSTR = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::SecureStringToBSTR($sec)
    try { return [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::PtrToStringBSTR($BSTR) }
    finally { if($BSTR -ne [IntPtr]::Zero){ [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::ZeroFreeBSTR($BSTR) } }
  }
  return $plain
}

function NSSM-Check(){
  if(-not (Test-Path $NssmPath)){ throw "Nie znaleziono NSSM: $NssmPath" }
}

function NSSM-Install($name, $application, $parameters, $appDir, $envExtra, $stdout, $stderr, [switch]$DelayedStart, [switch]$NoConsole){
  & $NssmPath stop   $name 2>$null | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath remove $name confirm | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath install $name $application | Out-Null

  & $NssmPath set $name AppParameters  $parameters | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath set $name AppDirectory   $appDir     | Out-Null
  if($envExtra){ & $NssmPath set $name AppEnvironmentExtra $envExtra | Out-Null }

  if($stdout){ & $NssmPath set $name AppStdout $stdout | Out-Null }
  if($stderr){ & $NssmPath set $name AppStderr $stderr | Out-Null }

  & $NssmPath set $name AppRotateFiles   1        | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath set $name AppRotateOnline  1        | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath set $name AppRotateBytes   10485760 | Out-Null
  & $NssmPath set $name AppRotateSeconds 86400    | Out-Null
  if($NoConsole){ & $NssmPath set $name AppNoConsole 1 | Out-Null }
  if($DelayedStart){ & $NssmPath set $name Start SERVICE_DELAYED_AUTO_START | Out-Null }
}

function NSSM-SetLogon($name, $user, $plainPassword){
  if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($user)){ return }
  if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($plainPassword)){
    Warn ("Usługa ${name}: brak hasła do ObjectName=${user}. Ustaw ręcznie (nssm edit) lub podaj -SecurePassword.")
    return
  }
  & $NssmPath set $name ObjectName $user $plainPassword | Out-Null
}

function Write-File($path, [string]$content){
  $dir = Split-Path $path
  Ensure-Dir $dir
  Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Value $content -Encoding UTF8
  Unblock-File -LiteralPath $path -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Info "Zapisano: $path"
}

function Acquire-Lock { if (Test-Path $LOCK) { $false } else { New-Item -ItemType File -Path $LOCK -Force | Out-Null; $true } }

function Run-Once {

# --- Funkcja: generowanie wrappera z logowaniem ---
function New-LogWrapper {
  param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$WrapperPath,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$CommandLine,
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$LogPath
  )
  $content = @"
`$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
`$ts = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
"[$ts] START $CommandLine" | Out-File -FilePath "$LogPath" -Append -Encoding utf8

try {
  & $CommandLine 1>> "$LogPath" 2>> "$LogPath"
} catch {
  "`$($_.Exception.Message)" | Out-File -FilePath "$LogPath" -Append -Encoding utf8
}

`$ts2 = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
"[$ts2] END $CommandLine" | Out-File -FilePath "$LogPath" -Append -Encoding utf8
"@
  $content | Set-Content -Path $WrapperPath -Encoding utf8 -Force
}

# --- 1) fetch + features co 10 min ---

function Ensure-Dir($p){ if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $p | Out-Null } }

function PS-Host(){
    if($UsePwsh7){
        $p = "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe"

function Cleanup-PPOFolders {
    Log "Czyszczenie folderów PPO ($PPO_DIR) – zachowuję $KEEP_FOLDERS"
    if (-not (Test-Path $PPO_DIR)) { return }
    $folders  = Get-ChildItem $PPO_DIR -Directory | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending
    $toRemove = $folders | Select-Object -Skip $KEEP_FOLDERS
    foreach ($f in $toRemove) {
        try {
            $best = Join-Path $f.FullName "best_model.zip"
            if (Test-Path $best) {
                $dest = Join-Path $MODELS ("best_" + $f.Name + ".zip")
                Copy-Item $best $dest -Force
                Log "Zapisano kopię modelu: $dest"
            }
            Remove-Item $f.FullName -Recurse -Force
            Log "Usunięto folder: $($f.Name)"
        } catch {
            Log "Błąd usuwania $($f.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

function Cleanup-ServiceLogs {
    Log "Czyszczenie logów usług starszych niż $KEEP_LOG_DAYS dni ($SERV_DIR)"
    if (-not (Test-Path $SERV_DIR)) { return }
    $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-$KEEP_LOG_DAYS)
    Get-ChildItem $SERV_DIR -File | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt $cutoff } |
        ForEach-Object {
            try {
                Remove-Item $_.FullName -Force
                Log "Usunięto log: $($_.Name)"
            } catch {
                Log "Błąd usuwania logu $($_.Name): $($_.Exception.Message)"
            }
        }
}

        Log "Cleanup zakończony"
    } catch {
